notes: Machine-readable layered-source contract for the Reimu slouch (趴桌/伏案) pose family.

Consumer-side authoring metadata, like pets/reimu/layers/eating/layer-set.json. tools/build_reimu_animations.py turns it into the inline `source` object of a Sprite Harness Animation Plan v2; it is not a harness schema.
Layers must be explicitly authored PNGs under asset_root; never derive them from the flattened base.png or from the eating sprites by segmentation, thresholding, inpainting or bbox guessing.

Full 596x596 RGBA transparent canvases with every part already in final composition coordinates, and identity placement (custom anchor 0,0 at 0,0) — the same export policy the calibrated eating pilot uses, so the two sets share one coordinate system.

z-order is the reason this set exists separately. `table` sits at z 60, ABOVE body and head, and its top edge is y=379 while the upright head's bottom edge is y=375. Anything that must read as resting ON the table therefore lives above the table: arm_rest 62, arm_prop 65, head 70, eyes 80/81, mouth 90, hand_prop 95.
tatami.png and table.png are byte-identical copies of the eating set's shared layers, so the ground plane and the table never shift between pose families.
The body's contact edge with the tatami must stay at y=547, matching assets/reimu/layered/eating/shared/body.png, so the app-side placement of this canvas is deterministic.
Only the pose_prop state is declared. sleep_table is the planned second slice and must not be added until its art is authored.

eyes_open and eyes_closed share visibility_group 'eyes'. A state that has both present MUST declare layer_visibility for the group; otherwise the builder fails closed rather than compositing both layers on top of each other.

alpha_hygiene calibration: every approved layer in the eating rig scores 0 or 1 at isolation_radius 7, while the historical defect was faint pixels scattered across the whole canvas. A soft edge up to about three pixels wide is accepted.

joins/legible_at calibration: in the approved eating rig a connected limb shares 1412-2188 adjacent pixels and a limb that reads at 160px moves 111-572 pixels when removed. The floors are set well below those (600 and 100) so only a genuinely broken or invisible limb fails. The pet is displayed at 160px, so that is the size that counts.

An earlier clean_sockets check was removed: the approved face skin has a mean of 229 and the bow's lace is pure white, so a luma threshold inside the socket box cannot separate sclera from skin or frills. It reported 434 defects in artwork that has none.

palette measures presence, not dominance: the share of a layer's opaque pixels within 18 of the approved colour. Calibrated on the approved eating rig, where skin layers score 12.2-27.3% and the dress 4.7%, against the first slouch delivery at 0.2-5.8% skin. Floors are 8% for skin and 3% for dress red, which leaves margin on both sides.

An eye_cover check was removed with clean_sockets. It required eyes_closed to cover the eyes_open footprint, which is only necessary if the head bakes eye rendering. The approved head's sockets are plain skin, so its closed layer is a lash line covering 4301 fewer pixels — working artwork that the check failed.

layers.notes: Ground plane, byte-identical to the eating set. It must never breathe, bob or bounce.
Forward-leaning torso, skirt, legs and detached sleeves. Excludes head, arms, hands and props. Its lower part is occluded by the table; contact edge with the tatami stays at y=547.
Low table, byte-identical to the eating set. Occludes the body; everything resting on it must sit above this z.
The non-propping arm and its hand, lying on the table or at the side.
Propping arm: elbow on the table through the forearm, ending at the wrist. Excludes the hand.
Hair, large red bow and face base. Excludes eyes, eyebrows and mouth, so the sockets stay plain skin and either eye layer can be shown.
Open eyes and eyebrows for the lowered head angle. Exactly one member of the 'eyes' visibility group is composited per frame.
Closed eyes and eyebrows for the lowered head angle. It need not cover the eyes_open footprint: the head's sockets are plain skin, so hiding eyes_open already reveals clean skin.
Relaxed closed mouth for the lowered head angle.
The hand supporting the cheek. Drawn in front of the face, so it is the topmost character layer.
Reserved and intentionally unauthored. No Zzz text, floating symbols, particles or danmaku are permitted in this pose family.
